title: ReferralIssued
description: A clinic issued a referral to a clinic of another tenant (e.g. physiotherapy, PT04) through Kiorex. A patient consent token is required (KX-09 §04). Carries a secure link and ids only; the referral content is fetched by the receiver with the consent token, never embedded here.

toClinicId.description: Receiving clinic when the patient chose one; otherwise the receiver is resolved by Kiorex.

toProfession.description: ADR-029. Market packs may extend the list in a later additive minor.

patientRef.description: Kiorex subject or Kiorly patient reference; never a national ID.

consentToken.description: Opaque token derived from the patient's active record-share grant (rsc_...).

aggregateType.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.

aggregateId.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.
